newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower despite holiday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate ends lower despite holiday.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate closed lower on Thursday as demand for liquidity ahead of Friday's Mid-Autumn festival was not enough to mop up excess money in the market, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.653 percent against Wednesday's 4.683 close, with 30-day commercial paper staying unchanged at 4.75-5.80. Dealers expected the rates to remain steady in the near term.
The bond market did not see transaction in the afternoon. The seven-year 85/3 bond yield was at 5.4800 against 5.5900 after morning trade. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
